description: Film page — intro: split with the film production image, three-step list and the film enquiry CTA.

intro.default: From indie shorts to full feature films, we deliver high-caliber cinematic execution at transparent cost. Our crews film on location in New York City and Singapore, backed by a portfolio led by our own production, Mad Vibe City.

default.heading: Consult & Budget
default.text: We scope your story, timeline, and budget — with clear costing before a single frame rolls.

default.heading: Pre-Production
default.text: Scriptwork, casting, locations, and scheduling across our NYC and SG networks.

default.heading: Shoot & Post
default.text: Professional cinematography, editing, sound design, and color grading to release-ready quality.
